xmldoc.short_description: Split datetime values into year, month, and day components.

param_input_item.param_description: datetime values, serial date numbers, or date-compatible input.

param_output_item.param_description: Three double arrays containing year, month, and day values.

description.p: Split datetime values into year, month, and day components.
ymd is a convenience wrapper around date vector extraction for calendar date components.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
